A strong wind brought anxiety to the Prophet's face, and he said he was granted victory with the wind As-Saba while 'Ad were destroyed by the westerly wind.
The Prophet was granted victory by the easterly wind and 'Ad destroyed by the westerly; clouds made him anxious until rain fell, lest they bring a tormenting wind.
The Prophet says he was granted victory by the easterly wind As-Saba, while the people of 'Ad were destroyed by the westerly wind Ad-Dabur.
